criteria.A: Server-rendered static month grid following the pinned Pikaday (.pika-single table) class contract, with month navigation and day selection wired as real links or submit buttons.
criteria.B: Server-rendered static month grid following the pinned vanilla-calendar (.vc data-vc grid) class contract, with month navigation and day selection wired as real links or submit buttons.
criteria.C: No server-rendered month grid: native date/datetime inputs plus the semantic agenda list stand as the complete calendar surface; rich pickers stay app-owned.

adapter.instructions: Which calendar month-grid approach best satisfies server-rendered no-JS presentation (functional without any widget script, accessible month navigation and day selection, styled by the pinned CSS, least dead markup) with the smallest contract the lane-05 library must own?

request.state: CanLang lane 05 builds @canlang/ui, a server-rendered daisyUI presentation library: pure HTML strings, no JavaScript, no hydration, no second date logic. Pinned daisyUI 5.7.47 calendar.css is adapter-only with no .calendar base class (verified in node_modules): it styles four third-party date-picker DOM contracts - .cally web-component parts, .react-day-picker/.rdp-* React markup, .pika-single Pikaday tables, and .vc/[data-vc] vanilla-calendar grids. The cally contract cannot render without its custom-element script, so it is excluded. Shipped C4 state: the calendar field control renders native date/datetime-local inputs and the agenda collection renders semantic day-grouped sections; both work fully without scripts. The open question is whether C7 should add a visual month grid, and if so which adapter contract the static markup follows. Any static grid must keep every control functional through links or form posts, since no widget script will run.
